headline: GOLD SURGES TO SEVEN-WEEK HIGH $4,278 IN 4TH STRAIGHT SESSION — Eyes $4,334 As Dollar Slides; NFP Thursday The Key Test For Hormuz-Driven Rally
snippet: Gold climbed to $4,278 on August 6, 2026 — a seven-week high — rising for the fourth consecutive session and gaining nearly 6% on the week as the partial Strait of Hormuz shipping corridor deal pushed oil prices lower, easing inflation fears and prompting markets to price in just one Fed rate hike by year-end (down from two a week earlier). The ADP employment miss (44K vs. 70K forecast) reinforced the softer rate trajectory, while a declining US dollar provided an additional tailwind. Analysts at FX Leaders see near-term resistance at $4,334, with $4,350 as the key level bulls need to clear to confirm a durable structural break rather than a dead-cat bounce. Thursday's Non-Farm Payrolls is the swing factor: a hot print above 90K could rapidly reprice rate hike expectations and put the week's gains at risk, while a soft print below 80K would likely confirm the Hormuz-ADP macro shift and open the door to a retest of the January record above $5,000.

headline: EQUINOX GOLD Q2: 176,836 OZ, 50% DIVIDEND HIKE, VALENTINE PHASE 2 APPROVED — Guidance Lifts To 870K–920K Oz Post-Orla Merger; $0.09/Share Annual Rate (TSX/NYSE: EQX)
snippet: Equinox Gold Corp. (TSX/NYSE: EQX) reported Q2 2026 results on August 5 showing production of 176,836 ounces and year-to-date output of 374,464 ounces, simultaneously raising consolidated 2026 production guidance to 870,000–920,000 ounces following the July 31 close of the Orla Mining business combination and increasing the quarterly dividend by 50% to US$0.0225 per share ($0.09 annualised). The Board also approved Phase 2 expansion at the Valentine Gold Mine in Newfoundland — taking processing capacity to 13,700 tonnes per day and annual production to ~223,000 ounces by late 2028 — a C$400M+ capital decision that signals management confidence in sustaining margins at $4,200 gold. On a pro-forma basis that includes a full year of Orla production, consolidated 2026 guidance would be ~1.1 million ounces. The combination and capital allocation decisions make Equinox one of the fastest-scaling gold producers in North America, with over 60% of production now sourced from long-life Canadian mines. EQX shares were up 6.79% on the news.

headline: GLENCORE H1 2026: EBITDA SURGES 86% TO $10.1B ON COPPER RALLY AND TRADING BOOM — Copper Margins 52%, Full-Year Illustrative EBITDA $19.7B; $3.5B Shareholder Returns
snippet: Glencore Plc reported H1 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $10.1 billion on August 5 — an 86% increase year-on-year — driven by a near-record marketing division contribution of $3.3 billion and a 72% surge in industrial EBITDA to $6.5 billion. Copper production rose 15% in the half-year period, with copper EBITDA margins reaching 52% as prices averaged well above $10,000/tonne; zinc added $0.9 billion at 38% margins. Net income was $4.4 billion with funds from operations up 158% to $8.1 billion. Full-year 2026 illustrative EBITDA is guided at ~$19.7 billion, and shareholder returns for the year will total $3.5 billion including a $1 billion cash distribution and $500 million buyback. For junior copper and zinc developers, Glencore's half-year validates the sustained commodity price environment: at 52% EBITDA margins on copper, the incentive for portfolio consolidation of high-grade junior developers into a major's pipeline is higher than at any point in the prior decade.

headline: CENTRAL BANKS BOUGHT RECORD 289 TONNES OF GOLD IN Q2 — Poland +82 Tonnes YTD, China 21 Consecutive Months; WGC Q2 Data Shows Fivefold Jump From Q1
snippet: The World Gold Council's Q2 2026 Gold Demand Trends report, released August 5, shows central bank net gold demand reached 289 tonnes in the quarter — a fivefold increase over Q1's revised 57 tonnes and a record high for any second quarter in the data series. The National Bank of Poland was the largest single buyer in June, adding 19 tonnes to bring its 2026 YTD total to 82 tonnes, while China reported a 15-tonne increase in June, extending its unbroken buying streak to 21 consecutive months. Money Metals notes that in its latest World Gold Council survey, central bankers overwhelmingly expect global gold reserves to continue expanding over the next 12 months — a structural demand floor that remains intact regardless of the short-term rate-hike pricing swings driving the current $4,200-level gold volatility. For retail investors evaluating whether $4,200 gold is sustainable, central bank accumulation at these prices is the single most important structural data point: sovereign buyers who do not trade for profit are absorbing supply.

headline: DISCOVERY MINING DOME: 278 g/t AU SPIKE IN PIT EXTENSION + OWL CREEK 19.35 g/t Over 5.4m — Underground Drift Advancing From Hoyle Pond; Dual MREs On Track Q4 2026 (TSX: DSV)
snippet: Discovery Mining Ltd. (TSX: DSV, OTCQX: DSVSF) released results from 55 diamond drill holes (17,845.5 metres) completed Q4 2025 through Q2 2026 at its Dome, TVZ and Owl Creek projects in Ontario's Porcupine Mining District on August 5, 2026. At Dome, drilling within and below the existing resource pit shell returned high-grade extensions including 14.76 g/t Au over 7.8 metres, 9.09 g/t over 17.3 metres, and a high-grade spike of 278.48 g/t gold over 1.1 metres below the north pit wall — the type of deep sulphide enrichment zone that often anchors underground mine designs in Porcupine camp geology. At Owl Creek, the program returned 7.09 g/t over 17.0 metres (including 23.12 g/t over 2.0m) and 19.35 g/t over 5.4 metres (including 270.0 g/t over 0.3m), while a 1.5-kilometre underground drift from the adjacent Hoyle Pond Mine toward Owl Creek is now underway — indicating potential for direct ore haulage infrastructure sharing with a producing mine. Resource estimates for Dome and TVZ remain on track for Q4 2026.

headline: AZTEC TOMBSTONE NORTH EXTENSION: 88.4m AT 1.42 g/t AU IN FIRST STEP-OUT HOLES — 6.1m At 12.23 g/t Au, 56 g/t Ag; Zone Open At Depth, Maiden Resource Q3 2026 (CVE: AZT)
snippet: Aztec Minerals Corp. (CVE: AZT, OTCQB: AZZTF) reported August 5, 2026 assay results from nine reverse circulation drill holes (TR26-31 through TR26-39) at the Tombstone Property in southeastern Arizona, with the first step-out into the North Extension Zone returning 88.4 metres at 1.42 g/t Au and 14.58 g/t Ag (1.69 g/t AuEq), including a 6.1-metre high-grade core of 12.23 g/t Au and 56.28 g/t Ag. In the Contention Zone, hole TR26-38 returned 97.5 metres at 1.06 g/t Au and 16.08 g/t Ag from surface — a wide, near-surface intercept directly comparable to grades exploited in bulk-tonnage open-pit oxide gold mines throughout the American Southwest. The North Extension is open along strike and at depth, with eleven additional step-out holes (TR26-40 through TR26-50) awaiting assay results. Aztec has expanded the Tombstone drilling program by 3,500 metres and a maiden resource estimate is targeted for Q3 2026 — the primary de-risking milestone for this project.

headline: TOCVAN DRILLS 215m AT 0.6 g/t AU ON MEZQUITE TREND — New Discovery 1.9km From Planned Pilot Facility At Gran Pilar, Sonora; Lower Zone 70.2m At 0.9 g/t (CSE: TOC)
snippet: TOCVAN Ventures Corp. (CSE: TOC, OTCQB: TCVNF) announced August 6, 2026 a significant new gold-silver discovery along the El Mezquite trend at its Gran Pilar Project in Sonora, Mexico, with hole JES-26-155 returning 215 metres of 0.6 g/t gold from 36.6 metres downhole — one of the widest gold intersections drilled on the project. The zone breaks into an upper intercept of 86.9 metres at 0.6 g/t Au and a lower intercept of 70.2 metres at 0.9 g/t Au, separated by a continuous low-grade zone, with three high-grade spikes of up to 16.0 g/t Au and 57 g/t Ag over 1.5 metres. The El Mezquite discovery sits just 1.9 kilometres east of Tocvan's planned pilot production facility along existing road infrastructure — a proximity that materially reduces haulage costs if the zone proves up to resource status. Gran Pilar is an active development project with a planned pilot mine, making this discovery directly accretive to the project's production profile rather than purely an exploration-stage result.

headline: ORETERRA DRILLS TREK SOUTH PORPHYRY — First Hole Underway On Glacially-Exposed 1.6km Target Adjacent To Galore Creek Copper-Gold; Never Previously Drilled (TSX-V: OTMC)
snippet: Oreterra Metals Corp. (TSX-V: OTMC) announced in early August 2026 that the first drill is turning at its Trek South porphyry copper-gold prospect in British Columbia's Golden Triangle — a 1.6-kilometre-wide zone of porphyry-style alteration exposed by recent glacial retreat and located directly adjacent to Teck Resources and Newmont's partially constructed Galore Creek porphyry deposit, one of Canada's largest undeveloped copper-gold assets. Trek South has never previously been drill-tested; Oreterra's maiden Phase 1 program covers approximately 5,000 metres of angled core holes designed to test coincident IP, magnetotelluric, and magnetic anomalies that underlie the surface alteration footprint. A second drill is expected to join the program within a week. The Golden Triangle's track record of world-class porphyry copper-gold discoveries makes any maiden drill program on an untested IP anomaly proximal to a confirmed giant deposit a high-priority watch for TSX-V resource investors.

headline: FORRESTANIA DOUBLES BRITISH HILL GOLD RESOURCE — 131% MRE Uplift To 126,290 Oz At 1.50 g/t Au; Indicated Rises 180% To 86,080 Oz; 3 Rigs Drilling (ASX: FRS)
snippet: Forrestania Resources Ltd. (ASX: FRS) delivered a 131% mineral resource estimate upgrade at the British Hill gold deposit in Western Australia on August 5, 2026, lifting total resources to 2.62 million tonnes at 1.50 g/t gold for 126,290 ounces from a previous estimate of 54,590 ounces. The Indicated Resource category — the higher-confidence component used in mine planning — increased 180% to 1.88 million tonnes at 1.43 g/t Au for 86,080 ounces, supported by a recent 19-hole drilling campaign totalling 4,764 metres that included 693 metres of diamond tails. Three RC drilling rigs remain on site with drilling continuing, and Forrestania believes material additional resource growth is achievable. For context, Western Australia's gold exploration space is seeing junior resource upgrades accelerate as the elevated gold price environment improves project economics and incentivises drilling-to-resource conversion ahead of possible deal activity — British Hill's updated economics at $4,200 gold warrant a fresh valuation look.

headline: LODESTAR METALS GOLD RUN NEVADA: MAIDEN DRILL CONFIRMS HEAP-LEACH OXIDE GRADES AND HIGH-GRADE SHOOTS — Robbers Knob Shows Multi-Style Gold-Silver System (TSX-V: LSTR)
snippet: Lodestar Metals Corp. (TSX-V: LSTR) reported August 5, 2026 assay results from the first six reverse-circulation holes of its maiden 2,680-metre drill program at the Gold Run Project in northern Nevada, with initial results at the Robbers Knob target confirming three mineralisation styles in 1,143 metres of drilling: broad near-surface oxide gold-silver intercepts spanning 30–70 metres at grades consistent with Nevada heap-leach operations, structurally controlled high-grade gold-silver shoots comparable to bonanza-grade veins in Nevada epithermal systems, and a deeper polymetallic zone. The multi-style character of Robbers Knob is a positive geological signal indicating a large, hydrothermal system with potential for both bulk-tonnage open-pit and higher-grade underground components — a combination that broadens the range of potential development scenarios and acquirer interest. Additional results from the remaining 1,537 metres of the maiden program are pending.

headline: FXEMPIRE: 'THE NEXT HALF OF THE BULL MARKET BEGINS' FOR GOLD AND MINERS — Mid-Cycle 2006 Analogue Points To 4–6 More Years Of Upside; Miners Set To Take The Lead
snippet: FXEmpire's August 5, 2026 analysis argues that gold and silver have completed the mid-cycle correction that followed January's $5,598 record, with the 2026 pullback to the $3,800–$4,100 zone mirroring the 2006 consolidation that marked the halfway point of the 2001–2011 secular bull market. Under this framework, another four to six years of upside remains in the current cycle, with gold targeting above $10,000 and silver above $300 by the early 2030s — driven by the same forces that powered the first half (currency debasement, central bank accumulation, dollar reserve share erosion) now being amplified by geopolitical supply chain fragmentation and the critical minerals premium. The key investment thesis for mining stock investors: while physical metals led the first half of the cycle, mining equities historically take over market leadership in the back half as institutional capital rotates from futures and bullion positions into production leverage. At current GDX/GDXJ valuations relative to the gold price, the sector is positioned as it was in mid-2016 and early 2020 — both entry points that preceded 100–200% equity rallies.
